{{Top|leg}}
'''Songbuks''' were ruminant herbivores native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]]. They migrated across the moon from the tundra to the [[Water/Legends|ice]] caps. The [[ursod]]s, a carnivorous quadruped, preyed on the songbuk, following its migratory path.
